implementation_notes: RubyYen and stackprof for profiling; the biggest wins are usually eliminating ActiveRecord N+1 queries, string building in loops, and needless object allocation. `Benchmark.ips` is the right harness.
code_sketch:
require 'benchmark/ips'
Benchmark.ips do |x|
  x.report('map+sum') { orders.map(&:total).sum }
  x.compare!
end
pitfalls: Fixing Ruby micro-costs while an N+1 query dominates wall-clock time
Allocation-heavy code in the inner loop that GC then has to collect
